|translation='''Title:''' AT-AT Driver.

'''Card text:'''
Add 2 to the power of any combat vehicle this character pilots. If the combat vehicle is an AT-AT, add 3 instead of 2.

'''Lore:'''
AT-AT drivers pilot their walkers high above the battlefield. The infantry scorn them as cowards because 15 centimeters of reinforced armor protect them.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore explicitly says the infantry regard the drivers as cowards.
